name: MaleFemaleRatio
definition: Ratio of male superheroes to female superheroes Formula: COUNT(Gender='Male') / COUNT(Gender='Female'). Inputs: Gender = tab05.fld006; Superhero = tab07.fld008

name: AvgFemaleWeight
definition: Average weight among female superheroes Formula: AVG(Weight) WHERE Gender='Female'. Inputs: Weight = tab07.fld018; Gender = tab05.fld006

name: PublisherHeroCountDiff
definition: Difference in superhero counts between two publishers Formula: COUNT(Publisher='Marvel Comics') - COUNT(Publisher='DC Comics'). Inputs: Publisher = tab06.fld007; Superhero = tab07.fld008
aliases: difference in number of superheroes published

name: WeightDifference
definition: Difference between two superheroes' weights Formula: SUM(Weight WHERE FullName='Emil Blonsky') - SUM(Weight WHERE FullName='Charles Chandler'). Inputs: Weight = tab07.fld018; FullName = tab07.fld009

name: WeightVsAvgThreshold
definition: Weight compared to 79% of overall average weight Formula: Weight > 0.79 * AVG(Weight). Inputs: Weight = tab07.fld018

name: HeroCount
definition: Count of superhero records Formula: COUNT(Superhero). Inputs: Superhero = tab07.fld008

name: SuperStrengthTallCount
definition: Count of Super Strength heroes taller than 200cm Formula: COUNT(Superhero) WHERE Superpower='Super Strength' AND Height>200. Inputs: Superpower = tab09.fld022; Height = tab07.fld017; Superhero = tab07.fld008
